scope: one actual thin Book fill per variant on the same QA instances, users, semantic workload, machine, pinned SDK and two Rayon threads. Both use the same instrumented binaries and resident resources; only explicit native memory hygiene differs. All declared proof processes are sampled at one second intervals, including idle residents; sums may count shared pages and are not true peaks or host footprint. Complete new cold/warm ordinary job timing required. Source, reads, nonce and proofs remain fresh each job. Sequential balances/checkpoints and RPC variation differ; no steady-state TPS/general speedup claim. Proving phase includes SDK RPC and recursion. Full proof and exact fee/state endpoint validation retained.
